headline: Eight Youths Arrested Following Repeated Prank Calls In Hougang
seoTitle: Eight Youths Arrested for Hougang Pranks
metaDescription: Eight male teenagers aged 12 to 15 have been arrested in Singapore for public nuisance after allegedly targeting a Hougang residential unit.
aiSummaryBullets: Eight teenagers aged 12 to 15 were taken into custody following reports of public nuisance.
The suspects allegedly knocked on the doors and windows of a residential unit in Hougang multiple times before fleeing.
Law enforcement officials stated that the group participated in a prank that was subsequently documented and shared online.
aiContextParagraph: The Singapore Police Force has arrested eight male youths, ranging in age from 12 to 15, on suspicion of public nuisance. The arrests follow incidents at a residential address in the Hougang district, where inhabitants reported unknown individuals knocking on their doors and windows at night on multiple occasions before leaving the scene. According to preliminary findings released by local authorities, the youths recorded their actions during these encounters. The resulting footage was then posted and circulated on social media platforms, drawing attention to the series of pranks. Police investigations into the behavior of the minors are currently ongoing as officials examine the circumstances surrounding the repetitive door-knocking incidents. Under local legal statutes regarding public nuisance, those found guilty may face penalties for their involvement in causing annoyance to members of the public through such behavior.
whyItIsViral: The incident garnered coverage across two major national news outlets following the circulation of prank footage online.
